same_horizon_substepping.case_1257_special_pattern: The first 0.0008-day substep is valid but the second 0.0008-day substep requests retry; therefore even the one case with an independently valid 0.0008 single step does not traverse the complete 0.0016-day horizon under the frozen forcing and controls.

failure_mechanism.headcalc_control_flow: After normal exhaustion of MaxIt1 when fldtmin is false, HeadCalc restores the base soil state, sets fldecdt=.TRUE. and request_dt_reduction=.TRUE., increments internal_retries, and returns. The typed Reference binding maps this path to SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED / legacy-reference-retry.
failure_mechanism.interpretation: The five P2E16B Reference-invalid cases are nonlinear iteration-exhaustion/retry limitations of the fixed Reference solve, not hard physical-domain rejections and not RossFast-caused failures.

step_size_interpretation.reason: All five cases are valid at the larger 0.0064 and 0.0032-day steps and invalid at 0.0016 day; four remain invalid at every smaller tested step. Case 1257 is explicitly non-monotone because 0.0008 day converges while both 0.0016 and 0.0004 day do not.

near_saturation_capacity_regularization_.note: The B1.10 provider has a step-duration-dependent moisture-capacity floor only for head > -1 cm. The initial states are well outside that direct trigger. This does not exclude a later Newton-iterate interaction, but it is not sufficient as the primary explanation.

adjudication_answers.Q1: The five cases are numerical Reference retry limitations, not demonstrated physical-domain failures.
adjudication_answers.Q2: Yes. The dt-validity relation is non-monotone, most clearly for case 1257.
adjudication_answers.Q3: No. Under frozen physics and numerical controls, reducing the 0.0016-day horizon into 2, 4, 8 or 16 substeps does not produce a fully valid Reference sequence for any of the five cases.

supported: The P2E16B Reference-invalid cases are reproducible and belong to a Reference nonlinear-retry limitation class.
The limitation is not removed monotonically by reducing dt.
The Reference comparator itself has a bounded numerical-validity domain that must be treated separately from the candidate solver domain.
not_supported: A claim that the five cases can be rescued by ordinary timestep refinement.
A claim that RossFast is scientifically superior in those five cases solely because it may return a candidate where Reference retries.
Any retroactive increase of P2E16B primary pairwise counts.
Any widening of P2E14 thresholds or RossFast production admission.

next_permitted_action: If scientifically useful for REF-HIGH construction, preregister a separate Reference-only numerical-control sensitivity study that varies iteration budget or solver controls prospectively. Such work is exploratory/adjudicative and cannot change P2E16B primary evidence.
